capabilities: Detect questions written in Markdown (question line ending with ?, answer on the next line)
Present detected questions as an interactive quiz
Start a quiz on the current note via a ribbon icon or command
extras: The README mentions the plugin is similar to flashcards in Anki or Quizlet, but it does not sync with or integrate those services.
intentEvidence: Minimal Quiz aims to provide an even more minimalistic design with improved stability and no bugs.
motivation: The author wanted a more minimalistic quiz plugin than the existing Simple Note Quiz, with improved stability and no bugs.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to quiz yourself on note content, so testing yourself usually means moving to a separate flashcard tool.

relations.evidence: This project was inspired by Simple Note Quiz.

summary: Markdown-based quiz plugin that detects question-and-answer pairs in the current note and runs an interactive quiz on them.
